# Name
# Vendor-specified layout (4 MB flash) for the ESP32-2432S028R "Cheap Yellow
# Display" (sdkconfig.cyd). Dual-OTA app slots
# device.ota + auto-rollback
# (prod_data primary / prod_bak backup) at the end of flash. otadata selects
# the boot slot; device.ota writes the inactive ota slot. The non-UI build
# has OTA disabled (CONFIG_HOMEHUB_OTA_ENABLED=n) but keeps both slots so a
# future build can enable it without a re-flash boundary.
# The partition table lives at CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET=0x8000 (the IDF
# default; set in the overlay since sdkconfig.defaults moves it to 0x10000)
# so nvs/otadata/phy_init keep their standard offsets. All app slots are
# 64 KB aligned. Everything fits below 0x400000: the last byte used is
nvs
otadata
phy_init
ota_0
ota_1
prod_data
prod_bak
